def build_instance(rng):
    coefficient = rng.randint(1, 5)
    linear_coefficient = rng.randint(-10, 10)

    parameters = {"coefficient": coefficient, "linear_coefficient": linear_coefficient, "constant_term": constant_term}
    return parameters, answer, check
